declarations.currentStore: mirror of the UI-state registry in utilities-core.js; window.currentStore (registry accessor) is the source of truth
declarations.currentFactorySummaryMode: mirror of the UI-state registry (default 'daily'); window accessor is the source of truth
declarations.editingFactoryInventoryId: mirror of the UI-state registry (default null); window accessor is the source of truth
declarations._set_currentStore: only caller was notify-open.js, now assigns window.currentStore directly
declarations._set_currentFactorySummaryMode: no callers; assigned window.currentFactorySummaryMode which factory.js now writes directly
declarations._set_editingFactoryInventoryId: no callers; assigned window.editingFactoryInventoryId which factory.js now writes directly
declarations.closeYearInProgress: moved into adminFlags (modules/admin-flags.js) so core can read it without loading admin-data.js; window.closeYearInProgress is now a live getter instead of a one-time copy
declarations.closing: moved into adminFlags (modules/admin-flags.js) so core can read it without loading admin-data.js; window.closing is now a live getter instead of a one-time copy
declarations.restoring: moved into adminFlags (modules/admin-flags.js) so core can read it without loading admin-data.js; window.restoring is now a live getter instead of a one-time copy
